title: oreocarya rollinsii
intro: Oreocarya rollinsii, commonly known as the 'Rollins' oreocarya', is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Oreocarya rollinsii include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
